attchmntText: Kirloskar Electric Company Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of listing approval letters for the issue of 34,68,007 equity shares to Kirloskar Power Equipments Limited, a promoter group Company by way of preferential issue.
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Electric Company Limited has received listing approval from BSE Limited and in-principle approval from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited for the preferential issue of 34,68,007 equity shares to Kirloskar Power Equipments Limited. The shares have a face value of Rs. 10 each and were issued at a floor price of Rs. 115.34 per share. The distinctive numbers for these shares range from 66414072 to 69882078. Trading approval will be granted only after the company files confirmation letters from NSDL or CDSL regarding the credit of shares to beneficiary accounts. The company must apply for trading approval within seven working days from the date of grant of listing approval.

attchmntText: Kirloskar Electric Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Ind-AS unaudited financial results (standalone & consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kirloskar Electric Company Limited published its Ind-AS unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in Business Standard and Prajavani on November 07, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 06, 2026. Consolidated total income from operations was 69,582.41 Lakhs, with net profit after tax at 2,584.92 Lakhs. Basic earnings per share stood at 2.48. Renaissance Global Limited also approved its unaudited results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, on November 06, 2026. The Board declared a second interim dividend of 25 percent, or INR 0.5 per equity share. Rain Industries Limited approved its results for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, on November 06, 2026. Kwality Wall’s India Limited, Gland Pharma Limited, and Cholamandalam Financial Holdings Limited similarly approved their respective unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year or six months ended September 30, 2026, on November 06, 2026.

attchmntText: Kirloskar Electric Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 06, 2026, titled Press Release on the unaudited (Standalone and Consolidated) Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
